meta.name: nicheium
meta.author: SomeoneElse, Abdullah
meta.description:
Land on Exothermica, a planet kept hot by constant fires. Go on a journey to find the most niche element!

*Kind of* a joke mod to make fun of those aspiring to only add super niche content, for example chemical elements. We'll see how it goes.

Niche status: Kinda niche, we need more green marked elements on the niche table.
